say:3:1210719001:0.text: Ma'am, we're here to rescue you. Please don't be scared.
say:3:1210719001:0.source_cn: 女士，我们是来救你们的，别害怕。

say:4:1210719002:0.text: You're safe now. No one will harm you again.
say:4:1210719002:0.source_cn: 你们安全了，不会再有人伤害你们了。

say:9:1210719004:0.text: Let's lower your husband down first—
say:9:1210719004:0.source_cn: 那我们先把你丈夫放下来——

say:10:1210719005:0.text: No! This starfish-eating dung deserves what's coming to him!
say:10:1210719005:0.source_cn: 但我不想救他！你们也不要插手！这是他应得的。

say:13:1210719006:0.text: You guys must have a bigger goal here, right? Why don't you check for any other hostages, and I can just... stay here and watch over him.
say:13:1210719006:0.source_cn: 我会在这里看着他的……你们应该……还有别的事要忙吧？

choice_prompt:14:1210719006.text: You guys must have a bigger goal here, right? Why don't you check for any other hostages, and I can just... stay here and watch over him.
choice_prompt:14:1210719006.source_cn: 我会在这里看着他的……你们应该……还有别的事要忙吧？

say:15:1210719007:0.text: Do you know where Nara went?
say:15:1210719007:0.source_cn: 你知道奈拉会去哪里吗？

say:16:1210719008:0.text: Are you planning to confront her? She probably returned to the ship...
say:16:1210719008:0.source_cn: 你们要去找她算账？她……她应该回船了……

say:17:1210719009:0.text: I've left a mark for my subordinates. They'll arrive soon, don't worry.
say:17:1210719009:0.source_cn: 我给血薇帮的弟兄留了记号，他们随后就会来。放心，他们会...

say:21:1210719011:0.text: I'm not sure, but she seemed important. The other Water Wights salute her whenever she passes.
say:21:1210719011:0.source_cn: 我也不知道，但她好像地位不低，别的水鬼见了她都要行礼。
say:21:1210719011:0.male: I'm not sure, but she seemed important. The other Water Wights salute her whenever she passes.
say:21:1210719011:0.female: I'm not sure, but she seemed important. The other Water Wights salute her whenever she passes.

say:22:1210719012:0.text: I didn't recognize her voice earlier, but I know of her—<style="highlight">Bonnie, the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet</style>.
say:22:1210719012:0.male: I didn't recognize her voice earlier, but I know of her—<style="highlight">Bonnie, the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet</style>.
say:22:1210719012:0.female: I didn't recognize her voice earlier, but I know of her—<style="highlight">Bonnie, the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet</style>.

say:23:1210719013:0.text: Are you... here to get rid of the monsters?
say:23:1210719013:0.source_cn: 你们……是来铲除这帮恶鬼的吗？

say:27:1210719014:0.text: Yes! Sir Chippy will chase all the bad guys away for you, m'lady!
say:27:1210719014:0.source_cn: 没错，骑士满满会把坏人都打跑的！

say:28:1210719015:0.source_cn: 那就谢谢你们了，太好了……！

choice_prompt:29:1210719015.source_cn: 那就谢谢你们了，太好了……！

say:30:1210719016:0.text: Tesio...? Oh! You're here to rescue a companion, right? I don't know anyone called Tesio, but I do remember an old man with the same rose mark on his chest like the one you have. They took him onto the ship.
say:30:1210719016:0.source_cn: 泰西欧……？噢！我知道了，你们是来救同伴的，有个老头，...
say:30:1210719016:0.male: Tesio...? Oh! You're here to rescue a companion, right? I don't know anyone called Tesio, but I do remember an old man with the same rose mark on his chest like the one you have. They took him onto the ship.
say:30:1210719016:0.female: Tesio...? Oh! You're here to rescue a companion, right? I don't know anyone called Tesio, but I do remember an old man with the same rose mark on his chest like the one you have. They took him onto the ship.

say:33:1210719019:0.text: I was right, Tesio's on the Chainkeeper!
say:33:1210719019:0.source_cn: 我猜得没错，泰西欧果然在枷锁号上！

say:36:1210719020:0.text: Should we go after Nara first or search for Tesio?
say:36:1210719020:0.source_cn: 那我们是先追奈拉还是去找泰西欧呀？

say:37:1210719021:0.text: Nara was also heading towards the Chainkeeper. I believe we'll be able to find both of them there.
say:37:1210719021:0.source_cn: 奈拉往枷锁号的方向走了，我们跟上，也许都能碰到。

say:41:1210719022:0.text: Ma'am, thank you for the information. You're now under the Carmine Whispers' protection, but before we go, I have something to say.
say:41:1210719022:0.source_cn: 女士，感谢你提供的情报，血薇会庇佑你的。在走之前，我有...

say:46:1210719017:0.text: Yes, an old man with that mark on his chest was taken aboard by the Wights.
say:46:1210719017:0.source_cn: 见过，他被水鬼带进船了。
say:46:1210719017:0.male: Yes, an old man with that mark on his chest was taken aboard by the Wights.
say:46:1210719017:0.female: Yes, an old man with that mark on his chest was taken aboard by the Wights.

choice:29:1:2.text: Does this rose mark look familiar?
choice:29:1:2.source_cn: 你见过一个胸前别花的老头吗
choice:29:1:2.male: Does this rose mark look familiar?
choice:29:1:2.female: Does this rose mark look familiar?

say:47:1210719018:0.text: Come to think of it, I did see an old man in a red coat. They took him onto the boat.
say:47:1210719018:0.source_cn: 还有个穿红色大衣的老头，水鬼帮把他带进船上了。
say:47:1210719018:0.male: Come to think of it, I did see an old man in a red coat. They took him onto the boat.
say:47:1210719018:0.female: Come to think of it, I did see an old man in a red coat. They took him onto the boat.
